easy.def: Something you want to do and work hard for.
examples: My goal is to read ten books.
I kicked the ball to score a goal.
His goal is to learn to swim.

more.def: Something you are trying to reach or achieve.
examples: Her goal is to learn to play the violin this year.
Our class goal is to collect five hundred cans of food.
He set a goal to save enough money for a bike.
